rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Permanent Removal, Capital Improvements, or Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay specific relocation amounts per tenant and per unit, with additional amounts for elderly, disabled tenants, or households with minor children, for evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal of a unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.

coverage.summary: Covered units subject to specified no-fault evictions under the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay specific relocation amounts per tenant and per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly or disabled tenant, for evictions conducted under the Ellis Act.

coverage.summary: Covered units subject to Ellis Act evictions.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
